tasks.short: Prepare departmental paperwork from records already held.

steps.what: Hold records of departmental functions.
Prepare required paperwork from departmental records.
Check exceptions in the required paperwork.
File the checked departmental paperwork.

tasks.design: Records of departmental functions that already sit in {ERP} or {OPS_SYSTEM} stay there. The paperwork is filled from those fields and the lodging manager finishes the blanks and checks exceptions. {DOCS} files only the checked version. The existing store is not a new saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same departmental figures were copied onto a required form.
tasks.enabler_now: The figures are already stored, so the form can be filled and the person can check the exceptions.
tasks.still_hard: Anything the form asks that is not a stored field still needs the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager checks the paperwork and owns the exceptions. The form does not invent a figure.
tasks.altitude: Less of the week goes to copying figures that are already stored. The manager still checks every exception before the paperwork is filed.

reach.learn: Start from the checked paperwork, not from a fresh export

evidence.claim: A form can be filled from fields a system already holds, with a person checking the lines that do not match.

assumptions: The existing departmental records are system time and are excluded. They are not saved human labour.
The form is filled only from named fields: period, department, amounts and counts. Blank lines stay blank for the manager. The manager produces the exception check.
The task is labelled automate. The steps agree that the copy can be deterministic, and they keep the exception check.
The file step references the version the manager checked.
Upkeep is the form field map.
unknowns: Which required forms still need a figure that is not in the property or ledger system.
Whether the form is already a system report, in which case the prepare step is also existing system time.
research_questions: Which paperwork fields are already stored, and which are still typed?

already_counted.description: Checking paperwork exceptions is already in that step

incremental.description: Keep the form field map current

approvals.approved_version: departmental paperwork the lodging manager checked before filing

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The records already held are not saved human labour. The manager still checks exceptions. The retype of stored fields is the saving. 26 percent is work the system already does and is not saved human labour. The range sits under the central net and is not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Show accommodations and assign the one accepted.

steps.what: Show the accommodations to the guest.
Read which accommodations are free.
Assign accommodations after the showing.
Record which accommodations you assign.
Tell the guest which accommodations you assign.

tasks.design: The lodging manager shows the accommodation and assigns it. {OPS_SYSTEM} already shows what is free. It records the assignment only after the manager decides. Telling the guest stays in person.
tasks.previous_blocker: The assignment was written on the reservation after the showing, often a second time.
tasks.enabler_now: Availability is already on the property system. The write is the assignment the manager just made.
tasks.still_hard: Showing the room, and choosing it with the guest, stay human.
tasks.human_edge: The manager shows the room and assigns it. The record does not choose the room.
tasks.altitude: Showings stay. The assignment is written once, after the manager decides, and the guest is still told in person.

reach.learn: Record the assignment a person made, and do not let availability choose the room

evidence.claim: Recording an assignment a person has made is a write. Choosing the room is not.

assumptions: The assignment record stores the accommodation id the manager chose and the reservation id. The manager produces the choice. The free list is a read of the existing inventory, not a new match.
The write references the decision made after the showing.
The prior classes this as human. The steps agree on the showing and the assignment.
Upkeep is the accommodation identifiers, which the property system already maintains, plus a small check that the write still matches them.
unknowns: Whether the desk, rather than the lodging manager, already assigns rooms.
Whether 'rent' here is a lease negotiation rather than a room assignment.
research_questions: Who shows rooms today, the lodging manager or the desk?

already_counted.description: Reading which accommodations are free is already in that step

incremental.description: Check that assignment writes still match accommodation ids

approvals.approved_version: accommodation assignment the lodging manager made after the showing

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Showing and assigning remain. Recording the assignment after the decision is the saving. The range sits under the central net and is not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform marketing and public relations activities.

steps.what: Choose the marketing activities for the month.
Draft the public relations note from that choice.

loop.input: The activity the lodging manager chose and the last note they signed
loop.output: A public note that states only that activity
loop.check: The lodging manager rejects any claim they did not choose
loop.stop: One draft, at most 150 words. No offer is invented. No second pass.
loop.why_not_simpler: The note is prose, so a fixed template cannot carry the activity the manager chose this month

steps.what: Approve the public relations note before release.
Send the approved marketing note.
Note which marketing activities went out.

tasks.design: The lodging manager chooses the marketing activity and releases the note. A draft uses only that choice. {EMAIL} or {CMS} sends the released version and no other. The manager keeps the log of what went out. Nothing is posted unattended.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notes were written and sent from the same mailbox, with no separate acceptance.
tasks.enabler_now: Sending can be separated from writing, so the released version is the one that goes out.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what to say about the hotel stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager chooses the message and releases it. A draft is not a release.
tasks.altitude: Choosing and releasing the message stay. The send uses the released version. The manager still notes what went out.

reach.task: Answer a guest asking about a published offer
reach.learn: Quote only the note the lodging manager released

evidence.claim: A public note can be drafted from a choice a person made, and sent only after that person releases that version.

assumptions: The draft states only the activity the manager chose. It adds no price, no award and no review.
The send references the version the manager released. The log afterwards is the manager's own note of what was sent.
The prior classes this as amplify. The steps keep the choice and the release human.
Upkeep is the list of channels the note may use.
unknowns: Which channels the manager is allowed to post to.
Whether a brand or legal colleague must release the note instead.
research_questions: Who may release a public note for this hotel?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the draft note is already in that step

incremental.description: Keep the list of allowed channels current

approvals.approved_version: public relations note the lodging manager released for this activity

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Choosing and releasing the note remain. Sending the released version is the saving. The range sits under the central net and is not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Organize staff and convention personnel for meetings.

steps.what: Meet clients about meetings at this facility.
Organize staff and convention personnel.
Coordinate convention personnel for the meetings.
Review the staffing sheet for convention personnel.
Accept the staffing sheet for this facility.
Publish the accepted sheet for the meetings.

tasks.design: The lodging manager meets the client, organizes the people and coordinates them on the day. The staffing sheet is filled from the plan the manager already made. The manager accepts it, and {HCM} publishes that version. The meeting with the client stays.
tasks.previous_blocker: The staffing list was rewritten for each banquet from notes taken in the client meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: Once the manager has named who works, the sheet is a table and can be published after acceptance.
tasks.still_hard: The client meeting, and coordinating people during the event, stay human.
tasks.human_edge: The manager agrees the event with the client and accepts who works it. The sheet does not staff the event.
tasks.altitude: Client meetings and coordination during the event stay. The staffing sheet is published from the plan the manager accepted, rather than retyped.

reach.task: Brief banquet staff on the event
reach.learn: Brief from the accepted sheet, and raise gaps before the event rather than after

evidence.claim: A staffing sheet can be filled from names and times a person has already set, then published after that person accepts it.

assumptions: The sheet stores the event, the role, the name and the time the manager set. The manager produces the plan and the acceptance. It is not a solver and it does not score staff.
Publishing references the accepted sheet. The client meeting is not recorded.
The prior classes this as amplify. The steps keep the meeting, the organizing and the coordination human.
Upkeep is the role names on the sheet. Consent days cover telling staff the sheet will be shared.
unknowns: Whether convention personnel are the hotel's staff or a supplier's crew.
Whether the client signs the staffing plan as well.
research_questions: Who employs the convention personnel on a typical event?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the staffing sheet is already in that step

approvals.approved_version: staffing sheet the lodging manager accepted for this facility's meetings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The client meeting and the coordination remain. Publishing the accepted staffing sheet is the saving. The range sits under the central net and is not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Showings, client events and the choice of what to say in public stay. Departmental forms and staffing sheets are filled from records the manager has already accepted.
reach: The desk assigns a room only after a person has chosen it
Convention leads brief staff from the accepted sheet
skills_to_grow: Checking departmental paperwork against stored figures
Releasing a public note before it is sent
Accepting a staffing sheet before the event team sees it
role.ambitious_version: Paperwork, public notes and staffing sheets leave the office only in a version the manager has checked.
